morphology.pattern_note: 目前可核实的是历史人名中的 Naina，按完整名称成分识别，不拆为马来语词缀；输入包的词根标记不构成独立的构词学证据。

senses.zh_definition: 历史人名中出现的名称成分，如 Naina Suria Dewana；现有证据未确立其作为现代标准马来语普通名词的独立词义。
senses.en_definition: A component of an attested historical personal name, as in Naina Suria Dewana; no independent common-noun meaning in standard Malay is established here.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama khas orang yang terdapat, misalnya, dalam nama Naina Suria Dewana; makna tersendiri sebagai kata nama am bahasa Melayu baku belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处记录的是专名用法，正文中写作 Naina。所列名称是已见实例，并非高频普通词搭配。马来语释义为本次编写的说明，不冒称 DBP 官方定义。来源：[DBP PRPM：Naina 的百科检索结果](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=naina)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP’s encyclopedic search results identify Naina Suria Dewana as a merchant of Indian ancestry in historical Melaka and connect him with Sulalatus Salatin. They also report Naina Ceti as a possible original name of Nina Catu. These attestations establish historical naming contexts, but they do not establish the etymology or an independent Malay meaning of naina. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=naina)
